title: 第四千二百一十五章 鏖战尊者三第四千二百一十四章 鏖战尊者二
content_zh:
见八雷尊者竟是以这种方式来应对诸天神阵的威胁，这顿时让剑尘心中犯了难。
原本他就是计划用诸天神阵重创八雷尊者，将八雷尊者打的失去反抗能力之后，便可顺利的将御雷环套在他身上。
可剑尘却没有想到八雷尊者现在面对诸天神阵，直接就是一副不抵抗的摆烂姿态，一心求死。
以自身陨落为代价，威胁诸天神阵不敢妄动。
这反倒是让诸天神阵不好发挥了。
诸天神阵的威力还可以继续降低，只需要减少仙帝以及仙君境强者的数量，神阵的威力便可大幅削弱。
可现在的难点是，如果神阵的威力大幅削弱，那就对八雷尊者构不成丝毫威胁了，由神阵催动的强大攻击，八雷尊者随手便可破去。反倒是组成诸天神阵的五万名九天玄仙境弟子，体内修为之力会严重损耗，单单是恢复修为就需要耗费不小的代价。
所以一旦陷入到以五万名九天玄仙和八雷尊者对拼修为的局面，剑尘这边自然拼不过，仙丹根本经不起消耗。
这还是没有考虑到八雷尊者不对诸天神阵出手的情况。
诸天神阵目前的防御力与攻击强度完全不成正比，一旦减少布置神阵的人数导致神阵威力减弱，那防护能力一样会跟着下跌。
到那个时候，八雷尊者如果对诸天神阵出手，那构筑阵法基石的五万名九天玄仙境弟子，最终还能活下来多少可就说不准了。
这绝对是剑尘无法承受的巨大损失。
“宗主，八雷尊者现在的实力已经大不如之前了，他的境界跌落到五重天，虽然正面打斗我依然不是他的对手，但差距已经没有之前那么大了。”千魂魔尊出现在剑尘身边，他浑身弥漫着滔天魔气，身上伤势正在快速恢复。
当然，他并没有享受生命之源的帮助，而是服下了上品神丹，尽管恢复速度远远不如剑尘，但也不算慢。
旋即他抬头望向高空中的诸天神阵，道：“没想到这老鬼竟然会用这种方法来应对诸天神阵的威胁，除非真的将这老鬼斩杀，否则诸天神阵还真派不上用场了。宗主，让噬仙妖花下来吧，我们一起围攻老鬼。”
闻言，剑尘目光上抬，落在了位于诸天神阵中心处的噬仙妖花身上。
如今的噬仙妖花是仙尊境三重天，比起千魂魔尊还是弱了一些。
千魂魔尊似乎看出了剑尘心中的顾虑，脸上情不自禁的流露出一丝委屈之色，道：“宗主，别看噬仙妖花的境界比我低了一些，可真要打起来，我已经快打不过它了，它的战斗力一点都不比我弱，我与它也只能勉强打一个平手。”
“不过它真正可怕的还不是战斗力，而是恢复能力。”
“它的恢复能力与再生能力尽管还比不上宗主，但同样十分变态，几乎不死不灭，反正现在它站在那里不还手让我打，我也打不死它了......”

说到最后，千魂魔尊的语气间带着一丝无奈。
自从噬仙妖花的实力踏入仙尊境三重天之后，他发现自己虽然是宗主麾下境界最高的存在，然而却已经不是最厉害的那个了。
此外，噬仙妖花的实力每天都在增长，一直都在持续不断的提升，从未停止过，随着时间的推移，他与噬仙妖花的实力差距只会越来越大。
“放老夫出去，否则，老夫纵然身死也不会让你们好过。”这时，八雷尊者突然传出怒吼，他化作一团炽目的雷霆光芒，带着狂躁的气息再一次狠狠轰击在诸天神阵上，打的诸天神阵剧烈晃动。
他这一击打出的力量，被诸天神阵层层抵消之后，分散到缔结阵法的所有仙人身上。
组成阵法的仙君以及仙帝境倒还好，并没有什么大碍。
可那五万名九天玄仙境弟子，许多人的面色都是一阵苍白，更是有少数九天玄仙，嘴角已经有鲜血溢出。
威力锐减的诸天神阵，显然承受不起八雷尊者的几次攻击。
那些九天玄仙境弟子的变化，立即被八雷尊者给察觉，这顿时让他眼睛一亮，心中陡然升起了一种绝处逢生的感觉。
“看来是老夫高看了这神阵，这残缺不全的诸天神阵，并不是不可破解！”八雷尊者大笑道，他毫不犹豫的燃烧自己的生命本源，整个人气势骤然大涨，尽管远不如他巅峰时期，但也勉强挤入了六重天之境。
“小家伙，不放老夫出去，那老夫就摧毁这座神阵！”八雷尊者一阵大笑，他浑身雷霆之力骤然收缩，瞬间凝聚成一柄雷霆战矛，以闪电般速度打在诸天神阵上。
“轰隆！”
一声巨响中，诸天神阵颤抖的更厉害了，阵法光幕忽明忽暗，缔结阵法的五万名九天玄仙境弟子，全部都齐齐喷出一口鲜血。
接连承受了八雷尊者三次重击，就连组成阵法的一些仙君，此刻面色也变得潮红起来，体内气血翻涌，震荡不止。
见此，剑尘立即给太初器灵和噬仙妖花传讯，让诸天神阵退走！
然而，八雷尊者已经看破了诸天神阵的弱点，又怎会轻易让诸天神阵撤走。
只见他的雷霆力量布满虚空，层层交织，宛若将这方虚空化作自身的雷霆领域，太初神殿的传送力量刚一出现，就遭到八雷尊者的疯狂破坏。
“哈哈哈哈，没了那些九天玄仙，老夫倒要看看你这神阵还有何用。”八雷尊者哈哈大笑太初神殿的力量远没有恢复，所以在这神殿内部，以他仙尊境五重天的实力足以和神殿的力量进行抗衡，不仅让太初神殿的力量奈何不得他，更是可以干扰太初神殿的一些举止。
也正是因为如此，太初器灵将剑尘和千魂魔尊二人传送走时，他们都得收敛自身力量与气息，以免形成抵抗，让太初神殿消耗太多力量。
顿时，诸天神阵步入险境，一旦遭受太多次攻击，那五万名九天玄仙必定遭受损失。

千魂魔尊一声怒吼，化作一片魔云，裹挟着仙尊境四重天之威再次朝着八雷尊者冲去，结果依旧被八雷尊者一拳击退。
“噬仙妖花，杀了他！”剑尘一声低喝。
当他这声音传出时，诸天神阵顿时光华冲天，映照整片天地，强大的能量波动疯狂震荡，再次展现出仙尊境七重天的无上威势。
八雷尊者心中一凛，面色一下子变得无比凝重，他感受到了神阵力量已经将他锁定。

content_en:
Seeing that Lord Eight Thunders actually used this method to deal with the threat of the All-Heaven God Formation, this immediately made Jian Chen feel troubled.
Originally, he planned to use the All-Heaven Divine Formation to severely injure the Eight Thunder Masters. After beating the Eight Thunder Masters to the point where he lost the ability to resist, he could successfully put the Thunder Control Ring on him.
But Jian Chen didn't expect that Venerable Eight Thunders were now facing the All-Heaven Divine Formation, showing a non-resisting attitude and wanting to die.
At the cost of his own death, he threatened the gods in the heavens and dared not act rashly.
This actually made it difficult for the All Heavens Divine Formation to perform well.
The power of the Divine Formation of the Heavens can continue to be reduced. As long as the number of Immortal Emperors and Immortal Lord Realm powerhouses is reduced, the power of the Divine Formation can be greatly weakened.
But the difficulty now is that if the power of the divine array is greatly weakened, it will not pose the slightest threat to the Eight Thunder Lords. The powerful attacks spurred by the divine array can be easily broken by the Eight Thunder Lords. On the contrary, the 50,000 Nine Heavens Mysterious Immortal Realm disciples who make up the All-Heaven Divine Formation will have a serious loss of cultivation power in their bodies, and just restoring their cultivation level will cost a lot of money.
Therefore, once they fall into a situation where 50,000 Nine Heavens Mysterious Immortals and Eight Thunder Masters are fighting against each other in cultivation, Jian Chen will naturally not be able to compete, and the elixir cannot withstand the consumption at all.
This still did not take into account the fact that the Eight Thunder Masters did not take action against the All-Heaven Divine Formation.
The current defense power of the All Heavens Divine Array is completely out of proportion to its attack strength. Once the number of people deploying the Divine Array decreases and the power of the Divine Array weakens, the protective capabilities will also decrease accordingly.
At that time, if Lord Eight Thunder takes action against the All-Heaven Divine Formation, there is no telling how many of the 50,000 Jiutian Xuanxian Realm disciples who built the cornerstone of the formation will survive in the end.
This is definitely a huge loss that Jian Chen cannot bear.
"Sect Master, the current strength of Lord Eight Thunders is not as good as before. His realm has dropped to the fifth level. Although I am still no match for him in a head-on fight, the gap is not as big as before." Thousand Souls Demon Lord appeared next to Jian Chen. His whole body was filled with overwhelming demonic energy, and his injuries were recovering quickly.
Of course, he did not enjoy the help of the source of life, but took the high-grade divine elixir. Although the recovery speed was far inferior to Jian Chen, it was not too slow.
Immediately, he looked up at the All-Heavens Divine Formation high in the sky and said: "I didn't expect this old ghost to use this method to deal with the threat of the All-Heavens Gods Formation. Unless this old ghost is really killed, the All-Heavens Gods Formation will really be of no use. Sect Master, let the Immortal-Eating Demon Flower come down, and we will besiege the old ghost together."
Hearing this, Jian Chen raised his eyes and landed on the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower located in the center of the All Heavens Divine Formation.
Today's Immortal Devouring Demon Flower is at the third level of the Immortal Realm, and is still a little weaker than the Thousand Souls Demon King.
The Qianhun Demon Lord seemed to have noticed the concerns in Jian Chen's heart, and he couldn't help but reveal a hint of grievance on his face, saying: "Sect Master, even though the level of the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower is lower than mine, if we really want to fight, I can't beat it. Its fighting power is not weaker than mine at all, and I can barely fight with it."
"But what's really scary about it is not its combat power, but its recovery ability."
"Although its recovery and regeneration abilities are not as good as those of the sect master, it is still very abnormal and almost immortal. Anyway, now that it is standing there without fighting back and letting me hit it, I can't beat it to death..."
At the end, Qianhun Demon Lord's tone contained a hint of helplessness.
Ever since the power of the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower entered the third level of the Immortal Realm, he discovered that although he was the highest realm existence under the sect master, he was no longer the most powerful one.
In addition, the strength of the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower is growing every day, and it has been continuously improving and has never stopped. As time goes by, the strength gap between him and the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower will only become wider and wider.
"Let me go out, otherwise, even if I die, I won't make it easy for you." At this time, Lord Ba Lei suddenly roared, and he transformed intoA ball of blazing thunder light, with a manic aura, once again hit the gods' formation, causing the formation to shake violently.
The power of his attack, after being offset by the formations of gods, was dispersed to all the immortals who formed the formation.
The Immortal Lord and Immortal Emperor who formed the formation were fine, and there was no serious problem.
But among the 50,000 disciples of the Nine Heavens Mysterious Realm, many of them looked pale, and there were even a few Nine Heavens Mysterious Immortals with blood spilling from the corners of their mouths.
The power of the All-Heaven Divine Formation was greatly reduced, and it was obvious that it could not withstand several attacks from Lord Eight Thunders.
The changes in those Jiutian Xuanxian Realm disciples were immediately noticed by Lord Ba Lei. This immediately made his eyes light up, and a feeling of survival from a desperate situation suddenly arose in his heart.
"It seems that I have overestimated this divine formation. This incomplete divine formation of the heavens is not indestructible!" Lord Ba Lei laughed. He burned his life source without hesitation, and his whole aura suddenly increased. Although it was far inferior to his peak period, he still managed to squeeze into the realm of the sixth heaven.
"Little guy, if you don't let me out, I will destroy this divine formation!" Lord Ba Lei burst into laughter. The power of thunder in his body suddenly shrank, and instantly condensed into a thunder spear, which hit the gods' formation at lightning speed.
"Boom!"
With a loud noise, the formation of the gods trembled even more violently. The light curtain of the formation flickered on and off, and all the 50,000 Nine Heavens Mysterious Immortal Realm disciples who had formed the formation spewed out a mouthful of blood.
Having withstood three heavy blows from Lord Eight Thunders in succession, even the faces of some of the Immortal Lords who formed the formation turned red at this moment, and the energy and blood in their bodies surged and trembled.
Seeing this, Jian Chen immediately sent a message to the Absolute Beginning Artifact Spirit and the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower, asking the gods to retreat!
However, Lord Eight Thunders has seen through the weaknesses of the All-Heaven Divine Formation, so how could he easily let the All-Heaven Divine Formation withdraw.
His thunder power filled the void, intertwined layer by layer, as if he had turned the void into his own thunder domain. As soon as the teleportation power of Taichu Temple appeared, it was crazily destroyed by the Eight Thunder Lords.
"Hahahaha, without those Nine Heavens Mysterious Immortals, I want to see what use your divine formation has." Lord Ba Lei laughed. The power of the Taichu Temple is far from being restored, so inside the temple, his strength at the fifth level of the Immortal Realm is enough to compete with the power of the temple. Not only does the power of the Taichu Temple not be able to help him, but it can also interfere with some of the behaviors of the Taichu Temple.
It is precisely because of this that when the Taichu Artifact Spirit teleported Jian Chen and Qianhun Demon Lord away, they had to restrain their own strength and aura to avoid forming resistance and causing the Taichu Temple to consume too much power.
Suddenly, the All-Heaven Divine Formation was in danger. Once it suffered too many attacks, the 50,000 Nine-Heaven Mysterious Immortals would definitely suffer losses.
The Thousand Soul Demon Lord roared and turned into a demonic cloud, carrying the power of the fourth level of the Immortal Realm and rushing towards the Eight Thunder Lord again. However, he was still punched back by the Eight Thunder Lord.
"The Immortal Devouring Demon Flower, kill him!" Jian Chen shouted.
When his voice came out, the divine formation of the gods suddenly soared into the sky, reflecting the entire heaven and earth. The powerful energy fluctuations oscillated wildly, once again showing the supreme power of the seventh level of the Immortal Realm.
Lord Ba Lei felt a chill in his heart, and his expression suddenly became extremely solemn. He felt that the power of the divine formation had locked him.
